title: Exact-derived chain square with specified comparison factors
statement: For four exact additive functors F,G,H,I and an isomorphism F ⋙ G ≅ H ⋙ I, a chain-level mixed square descends to the specified derived functors, with all localization comparison factors retained. The module also constructs the fixed good-complex, localization, reindexing and scalar representative maps used by this descent.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; passage from the chain square to the specified exact-derived functors; Stacks 05RU

proof.text: Move the localization factor for G past the input chain map by naturality. Combine the three Q-images and apply the assumed chain equation. Split the Q-images. The composition-factor and natural-isomorphism-factor equations identify the initial factors with the specified derived comparison. Move the factor for I past the other input chain map by naturality. Associativity gives the claimed square. The argument uses no invertibility of the chain maps, and includes zero and identity maps.

theorem podCoefficientExactSquareChain
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category* A] [Category* B] [Category* C] [Category* D]
    [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (G : B ⥤ D) [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (H : A ⥤ C) [H.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (I : C ⥤ D) [I.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits I] [PreservesFiniteColimits I]
    (s : F ⋙ G ≅ H ⋙ I) (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex B ℤ) (Q : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (Z Z' : CochainComplex D ℤ)
    (c : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ P)
    (d : (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ⟶ Z)
    (e : (H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ Q)
    (f : (I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ⟶ Z') (r : Z ⟶ Z')
    (hc : (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map c ≫ d ≫ r =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex s (.up ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
        (I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map e ≫ f) :
    G.mapDerivedCategory.map
        (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map c) ≫
      G.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map d ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map r =
    (((F.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso G).symm ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryNatIso s ≪≫
        H.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso I).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ≫
      I.mapDerivedCategory.map
        (H.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map e) ≫
      I.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f
